import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Parse body_mass_g from text to numeric
    df["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(df["body_mass_g"], errors='coerce')
    # Parse bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm, flipper_length_mm from number/text to numeric
    for col in ["bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm"]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # Remove negative flipper_length_mm and out-of-range values
    mask_flipper = (df["flipper_length_mm"] >= 170) & (df["flipper_length_mm"] <= 235)
    df = df[mask_flipper]
    # Fix sex: strip spaces and lowercase, drop unknown/invalid
    df["sex"] = df["sex"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df = df[df["sex"].isin(["male", "female"])].copy()
    # Validate species and island against allowed lists
    allowed_species = {"Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"}
    allowed_island = {"Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"}
    mask_species = df["species"].isin(allowed_species)
    mask_island = df["island"].isin(allowed_island)
    df = df[mask_species & mask_island].copy()
    # Validate numeric ranges
    mask_mass = (df["body_mass_g"] >= 2500) & (df["body_mass_g"] <= 6500)
    mask_bill_len = (df["bill_length_mm"] >= 30) & (df["bill_length_mm"] <= 60)
    df = df[mask_mass & mask_bill_len].copy()
    # Keep id column (penguin_id)
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species, sum body_mass_g per species
    grouped = df.groupby("species").sum(numeric_only=True)\n    result = {}
    for label, row in grouped.iterrows():
        # Only numeric columns are summed
        total_mass = row.get("body_mass_g", None)
        if pd.notnull(total_mass):
            result[label] = int(round(total_mass))
    # If all species present, add 'all' key
    if set(result.keys()) == allowed_species:
        result["all"] = sum(result.values())
    # Remove keys with missing total_mass (shouldn't happen here)
    result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if v is not None}
